quote: Kitaev and Pyatkin's 2008 paper 'On Representable Graphs' states several open problems including those related to planar graphs and word-representability
note: The problem appears as an open question in the 2008 Kitaev-Pyatkin paper 'On Representable Graphs' (Journal of Automata, Languages and Combinatorics, Volume 13, No. 1, pages 45-54), which introduced the systematic study of word-representable graphs. The specific characterization problem for non-word-representable planar graphs is also discussed as an open problem in the 2015 monograph 'Words and Graphs' by Kitaev and Lozin.
